Act I

The ride in

No driving into the city and no Manhattan parking. The pup gets a sleepover with your parents in Flemington, we leave the car at Somerville station, and the train does the rest.

  1. Drop the pup off in FlemingtonAbout an hour and 15 minutes from home, then 25 minutes up Route 202 to Somerville.
  2. Park at Somerville stationLot 1 on South Bridge Street. $20 covers us until Monday afternoon.
  3. Take the 1:18 PM trainRaritan Valley line, with a quick change at Newark Penn. Into Penn Station at 2:44. One ticket in the NJ Transit app covers both trains.

Act II

Our room for the night

Home base is the Pestana CR7 Times Square on West 39th Street. It's about a 10-minute walk from Penn Station and 6 minutes from the theater, so once we step off the train the whole night is on foot.

Everything's walkable

Penn Station, the hotel, dinner and the Lyric are all within about 15 minutes of each other on the West Side. Once we're off the train we never need a cab.

Act III

The show

Curtain at 7:00. Tap the stage for a little sorcery.

Lyric Theatre presents

Harry Potterand the Cursed Child

SunDec 207 PM

The story picks up nineteen years after the last book. Harry works at the Ministry of Magic, and his son Albus is struggling at Hogwarts with an unlikely best friend: Draco Malfoy's son, Scorpius. The play is famous for stage illusions people are still trying to figure out on the walk home.

Seats
Balcony, Row D, two together
Runs
Just under 3 hours, one intermission
Seated
By 6:30 PM, so we're not rushing the stairs
Doors
Entrances on both W 42nd and W 43rd Streets

Bonus: Tom Felton, Draco in the films, is playing Draco on Broadway through January 3. Casting can always change, but our odds are good.

The program

How the night plays out

SundayDecember 20

  2. 11:00 AM
    Leave home

    Overnight bags packed, the pup in the back seat.

  3. 12:15 PM
    Drop off the pup in Flemington

    A quick hello to your parents, then up Route 202.

  4. 1:00 PM
    Park at Somerville station

    Lot 1 on South Bridge Street.

  5. 1:18 PM
    Train to the city

    Raritan Valley line. Change at Newark Penn for the 2:24 to New York.

  6. 2:44 PM
    Arrive at Penn Station

    Up to the street and north on 8th Avenue.

  7. 3:00 PM
    Check in at the Pestana

    Drop the bags and get ready for the show.

  8. 4:40 PM
    Walk up to dinner

    About 15 minutes up 8th Avenue to West 49th.

  9. 5:00 PM
    Dinner at Churrascaria Plataforma

    Brazilian steakhouse, table for two. The skewers keep coming until we flip our cards to red.

  10. 6:30 PM
    Find our seats

    An 8-minute walk from dinner. Balcony, Row D.

  11. 7:00 PM
    Curtain up

    Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

  12. 10:00 PM
    Walk back to the hotel

    Six minutes, past the lights of 42nd Street.

MondayDecember 21

  2. Morning
    Slow breakfast

    Then a holiday walk if we feel like it. Ideas below.

  3. Late AM
    Check out

    Walk about 10 minutes back to Penn Station.

  4. Midday
    Train home

    Straight through to Somerville, no change. Trains leave Penn Station at 10:40, 11:40 and 12:45.

  5. Afternoon
    Pick up the pup

    Back to Flemington, then home.

Train times come from NJ Transit's schedule for these dates. Sunday trains run once an hour, so if we miss the 1:18, the 2:18 still gets us in by 3:42. We'll double-check the times in the app the week before.
